summary: Return fixed rational residue and pole tables indexed by Bessel order |n|+1.

capability: Return fixed rational residue and pole tables indexed by Bessel order |n|+1.
operation: maximum harmonic N to residue and pole tables for orders 0..N
discovery.model: rational approximation of Maxwellian finite-Larmor-radius terms
discovery.boundary: frozen tables cover |n|=0..7; requests beyond them fail

identity.relation: maximum harmonic N to residue and pole tables for orders 0..N
identity.direction: maximum harmonic N to residue and pole tables for orders 0..N
identity.definition: The fixed L-pole residues and positions approximate Bessel-Gamma terms by rational pole sums; table key is |n|+1.
identity.model: rational approximation of Maxwellian finite-Larmor-radius terms
identity.coordinates: integer harmonic and complex pole axes
identity.boundary: frozen tables cover |n|=0..7; requests beyond them fail
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: max_harmonic
inputs.description: Maximum Bessel order $N$ that the caller will assemble
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative integer, and `max_harmonic+1` does not exceed 8, the largest coefficient order in the frozen table.

outputs.name: orders
outputs.description: Returned coefficient-order list, that is, $|n|+1$ from 1 to `max_harmonic+1`

outputs.name: order_lengths
outputs.description: Number of poles at each coefficient order, $L(|n|+1)$
outputs.constraints: Values come from the frozen table.

outputs.name: residues
outputs.shape: Mapping keyed by order whose values are complex arrays of length `order_lengths[order]`

outputs.name: poles
outputs.shape: Mapping keyed by order whose values are complex arrays of length `order_lengths[order]`
outputs.constraints: Finite complex numbers; poles appear in complex-conjugate pairs.

outputs.name: total_poles
outputs.description: Total number of poles returned, $\sum_{|n|\le N}L(|n|+1)$
outputs.constraints: Equal to the velocity-block dimension per species in the dispersion matrix.

example.description: Return the order-one L-pole table and check its declared length.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import get_gamma_lpole_coefficients
r=get_gamma_lpole_coefficients(max_harmonic=0); assert r['order_lengths'][1]==12
